B&ZAIの8人を覚えたい。だから無人島を作った

前編でB&ZAIというsystemは分かった。でも八人の顔と名前が一致しない。So this sequel turns member learning into a memory experiment: chunk them 1-4-3 by former groups, attach instruments, use the official 'one thing to take to a deserted island' answers as distinctive cues, place everyone on one imaginary island, then close the page and retrieve.
